texts: In the late summer of Year 1, on the first night of her apprenticeship, Coraline Ash did not light a lantern.
Coraline Ash walked the Cliff Path with Pell from sundown to dawn.
Coraline Ash carried Pell's leather case.
Pell cleaned the glass of the lantern.
Pell trimmed the wick of the lantern.
Pell filled the reservoir of the lantern with mire-essence.
Coraline Ash wrote the steps in a notebook.

parse: (: e1_not_light (And (Member sk_light_1 light) (Agent sk_light_1 coraline_ash) (Patient sk_light_1 sk_lantern_1) (Member sk_lantern_1 lantern) (Past sk_light_1) (Time sk_light_1 late_summer) (Time sk_light_1 (Year 1)) (Time sk_light_1 sk_night_1)) (STV 0.0 0.99))

q1_issues.issue: (Member sk_lantern_1 lantern) is emitted twice — inside the strength-0 denial at index 6 (where the indefinite "a lantern" is required to stay) and again here at top level — so the same atom is double-counted and the denied indefinite ends up asserted to exist anyway.

q2_gaps: a non-deictic season expression ("the late summer of Year 1"): Time terms cover only Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute plus deictic and day-part constants, so "late summer" has no licensed form (the parse improvises the bare symbol late_summer)

a temporal adjunct naming a countable occasion ("on the first night of her apprenticeship"): the Time value slot is defined only for structured calendar terms, deictic constants and day-parts, and no during/before/after wording licenses the event-noun anchor route, so the parse puts an entity witness (sk_night_1) in the Time slot

Ordinal's scale slot for a time-period NP ("the first night of her apprenticeship"): the scale is specified as the associated event or an explicit "-est" dimension, neither of which this phrase supplies (the parse fills it with the class word night)
review.notes: Everything else follows the instruction set: negation scope with time atoms inside the strength-0 bundle, presupposed referents projected out, the Cliff Path multi-word name plus separate kind atom, leather_case / mire_essence genus-only decomposition, CoAgent for "with Pell", Start/End for sundown-to-dawn, and the definite-plural group for "the steps". Sentence 1's time frame is correctly not propagated to the later sentences.

issues.reason: The top-level (Member sk_lantern_1 lantern) is licensed — indeed required — by sentences 4-7, whose anaphoric definite "the lantern" reuses that witness (Coreference & anaphora: "an anaphoric definite re-mentioning an already-minted witness reuses that witness") and whose clauses assert the lantern's existence, while Names and casing bars an untyped referent symbol from appearing at all; and a conjunct of a strength-0.0 (And …) is not an independently asserted atom, so no atom is double-counted.

gaps_confirmed: season expressions have no Time term: the granularity list is Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute plus deictic and day-part constants, so "the late summer of Year 1" can only be a bare symbol that does not compose with (Year 1)

a temporal adjunct naming a countable occasion ("on the first night of her apprenticeship") has no licensed carrier: the Time value slot is defined for structured calendar terms, deictic constants and day-parts, and During is restricted to during/while/throughout, so an entity witness in the Time slot is the only route left

Ordinal's scale slot is defined as the associated event or an explicit "-est" dimension, and a ranked time-period NP ("the first night of her apprenticeship") supplies neither, nor any way to carry the ordering's domain (the apprenticeship)
new_gaps: an anaphoric definite in a later sentence picking up an indefinite that was introduced only inside a strength-0 denial ("did not light a lantern" … "the lantern"): the projection rule seals the indefinite's typing inside the bundle, but the later mention puts the witness at top level where an untyped symbol is barred — the instruction set does not say whether the typing is then re-emitted at top level, minted as a fresh witness, or something else, and a licensed form would need to say what asserts the referent's existence once a later sentence presupposes it
adjudication.notes: The improvisations in gap territory (late_summer on Time, the night witness on Time, night in Ordinal's scale slot) each emit only atoms true of the passage and well-typed in arity, so the calibration line keeps them acceptable. Negation scope, definite-referent projection, the Cliff Path name plus separate kind atom, leather_case/mire_essence genus-only decomposition, CoAgent, Start/End and the definite-plural group are all by the book.
